snippet.title: My Zombies Are Hungry — Official Gameplay Trailer | Grow 3 Zombies into 500+
snippet.description:
🧟 Wishlist My Zombies Are Hungry on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5239600/My_Zombies_Are_Hungry/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=mzah_launch_2026&utm_content=official_trailer

My Zombies Are Hungry is a darkly comic incremental auto-battler where you grow a handful of zombies into a city-eating horde of hundreds.

Launch short raids, buy permanent upgrades, build different zombie types from swappable body parts, and devour increasingly larger settlements while humanity escalates from police and firefighters to tanks and airstrikes.

FEATURES
• Grow from a few zombies to a horde of 500+
• Short automated raids with permanent progression
• Build different zombie types with swappable jaws, arms and legs
• Fight escalating human resistance
• Conquer 24 campaign sectors
• Progress from Village → Town → City → Megapolis

Developer / Publisher: GiantIce
Release: Coming soon on Steam

#MyZombiesAreHungry #zombiegame  #incrementalgame
